Class Vt100StatusLine

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.Vt100StatusLine
public final class Vt100StatusLine extends Object
The Vt100StatusLine type builds the thin status line for the VT100 console. The name VT100 means the console mode whose wire word on this line is VT100 or PTY. The link word leads the line. The link word is the connection text from west(String, String, String). The line does not print the word AMWP, the name of the Aetheris frame protocol. The line does not print the word raw. The two words stay on the Aetheris strip, the status strip of the canvas tab. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#Vt100StatusLine

      public static final String MOOD_ACTIVE
      The MOOD_ACTIVE constant is the text added when the SSH mood gate is on. The text is mood active. The mood string itself stays off this strip.

  • Method Details

    • modeWord

      public static String modeWord(String token)
      The modeWord method turns the stored connection mode into the wire word. The stored mode is the token under ui.connection.mode. The method returns PTY when the trimmed token equals pty, ignoring letter case. The method returns VT100 for a null token, a blank token, and every other token.
      Parameters:
      token - The stored connection mode. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is PTY or VT100.

    • airWord

      public static String airWord(String air)
      The airWord method returns the air-gap word for the status line. The air-gap word is the stored text that says whether the air gap is set. The method returns unset when the word is null. The method returns unset when the trimmed word is empty. The method returns the trimmed word for every other value.
      Parameters:
      air - The stored air-gap word. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the trimmed word, or unset when the word is blank.

    • engineWord

      public static String engineWord(String engine)
      The engineWord method returns the execution target for the status line. The execution target is the stored engine name. The method returns ollama when the target is null. The method returns ollama when the trimmed target is empty. The method returns the trimmed target for every other value.
      Parameters:
      engine - The stored execution target. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the trimmed target, or ollama when the target is blank.

    • facts

      public static String facts(String modeToken, String air, String engine)
      The facts method joins the vault word, the mode word, the air-gap word, and the engine word. The vault word is disk. The text begins with vault: disk. The next two spaces follow that phrase. The mode word follows those spaces. The next two spaces follow the mode word. The label air-gap: follows those spaces. The air word follows that label. The next two spaces follow the air word. The label engine: follows those spaces. The engine word follows that label. The mode word comes from modeWord(String). The air word comes from airWord(String). The engine word comes from engineWord(String).
      Parameters:
      modeToken - The stored connection mode under ui.connection.mode.
      air - The air-gap word.
      engine - The execution target.
      Returns:
      The return value is that fact string.

    • west

      public static String west(String status, String host, String port)
      The west method builds the link word at the left of the status line. The method treats a null status as an empty string. The method trims the status before it tests the word. The method returns Connecting when the trimmed status is Connecting or begins with that word. The method returns Connected, a space, the host, a colon, and the port when the trimmed status is exactly Connected. The method treats a null host as an empty string on that branch. The method treats a null port as an empty string on that branch. The method returns the trimmed status unchanged when it begins with Connected and is not exactly that word. The host and the port are ignored on that branch. The method returns Disconnected when the status begins with Disconnected and no reason remains. The method strips one leading colon, hyphen, or em dash from the reason. The method trims the reason and repeats that strip while such a mark remains. The method returns Disconnected, a space, an em dash, a space, and the reason when a reason remains. The method returns the trimmed status for every other word.
      Parameters:
      status - The link word. The value may be null.
      host - The connected host. The value may be null.
      port - The connected port. The value may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the link word for the left of the line.

    • join

      public static String join(String link, boolean moodGate, String facts)
      The join method builds the strip from the link word, the mood gate, and the facts. The method treats a null link as an empty string. The method puts MOOD_ACTIVE alone when the mood gate is on and the link is empty. The method appends two spaces and MOOD_ACTIVE when the mood gate is on and the link is not empty. The method returns that head alone when the facts are null or empty. The method returns the facts alone when the head is empty. The method returns the head, two spaces, and the facts when both parts have text.
      Parameters:
      link - The link word from west(String, String, String). The value may be null.
      moodGate - The SSH mood gate. The gate is on when the flag is true.
      facts - The vault, mode, air-gap, and engine text from facts(String, String, String).
      Returns:
      The return value is the joined strip.
